# Data schema

<!-- Generated by `uv run fnf-schema-doc` from src/fnf/schema.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every table the pipeline reads or writes. `src/fnf/schema.py` is authoritative: tables are
cast with `schema.coerce` on load and checked with `schema.validate` before they're written.

## Conventions

- `match_id`: replay file stem, e.g. `UnsavedReplay-2026.09.21-20.53.39`.
- `player_id`: Epic account ID, 32 uppercase hex characters. Bots: the bot's unique id, or `BOT_<state_player_id>`
  (match-scoped) for named NPC bots that have none.
- `t`: seconds since replay start (demo frame clock). `t_ms` is the same clock in ms (aligned to ~15 ms).
- Positions in Unreal units (1 uu = 1 cm). Build grid: 512 uu horizontal, 384 uu vertical. Angles in degrees.
- Interim per-replay CSVs (`data/interim/telemetry/<match_id>/<table>.csv`) have the processed columns minus `match_id`
  (the folder name). `meta.csv` becomes `matches`; `eliminations.csv` becomes `elims`; `builds.csv` becomes `pieces`.
- Types: `string`, `int`, `float`, `bool`. Nullable columns are marked; a null boolean flag means "not replicated in
  this update", not false.

## Raw

### `manifest`

`data/raw/manifest.csv`. Grain: replay file. Key: `replay_file`.

Provenance of every replay in data/raw/replays. Written by fnf-import; never edited by hand.

| column | type | null | unit | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `replay_file` | string |  |  | File name in data/raw/replays |
| `sha256` | string |  |  | Content hash; duplicates are skipped on import |
| `size_bytes` | int |  |  |  |
| `source` | string |  |  | local_demos \| donated \| tournament_ingame \| partner_osirion \| partner_other |
| `replay_kind` | string |  |  | client (recorder's view) \| server (whole island) \| unknown |
| `contributor` | string | yes |  | Pseudonymous contributor id (never a real name) |
| `consent_ref` | string | yes |  | Consent record id; required for donated replays |
| `acquired_at` | string |  |  | UTC ISO-8601 import time |
| `notes` | string | yes |  |  |

## Interim (per-replay)

### `eliminations`

`data/interim/telemetry/<match_id>/eliminations.csv`. Grain: knock or elimination.

Replay elimination events. Processed into the elims table.

> victim_*/actor_* locations decode incorrectly on 2026 builds; use positions at t instead.

| column | type | null | unit | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t` | float |  | s | Time since replay start |
| `eliminated` | string | yes |  |  |
| `eliminator` | string | yes |  |  |
| `knocked` | bool |  |  |  |
| `gun_type` | int | yes |  | Weapon class enum |
| `distance` | float | yes | uu |  |
| `victim_x` | float | yes |  |  |
| `victim_y` | float | yes |  |  |
| `victim_z` | float | yes |  |  |
| `actor_x` | float | yes |  |  |
| `actor_y` | float | yes |  |  |
| `actor_z` | float | yes |  |  |

### `builds`

`data/interim/telemetry/<match_id>/builds.csv`. Grain: piece actor spawn.

Raw build-piece spawns. Processed into pieces.

| column | type | null | unit | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spawn_t` | float |  | s | Piece spawn time (predicted spawn time if one preceded it) |
| `channel` | int |  |  | Actor channel index (reused after close) |
| `path` | string |  |  | Actor class, PBWA_<material><tier>_<shape>_C |
| `x` | float |  | uu |  |
| `y` | float |  | uu |  |
| `z` | float |  | uu |  |
| `yaw` | float |  | deg | Piece rotation |
| `close_t` | float | yes | s | Channel close time; null if open at replay end |
| `close_reason` | string | yes |  | Destroyed (broken/edited/removed) \| Dormancy \| Relevancy \| ... |
| `owner_persistent_id` | int | yes |  | Builder field; empty in client replays |
| `team_index` | int | yes |  | Team that owns the piece (null on predicted spawns) |
| `max_health` | int | yes |  |  |
| `min_health` | int | yes |  | Lowest health seen (damage taken) |
| `player_placed` | bool | yes |  |  |
| `editors` | string | yes |  | Editing players, ';'-separated; empty in client replays |

### `actor_classes`

`data/interim/telemetry/<match_id>/actor_classes.csv`. Grain: actor class. Key: `path`.

Spawn count per actor class; use it to find new PBWA_* shapes (ingest/gen_build_pieces.py).

| column | type | null | unit | description |

### `damage`

`data/processed/damage.parquet`. Grain: damage cue.

NetMulticast_Athena_BatchedDamageCues, called on the instigator's pawn.

> Validated: recorder's damage to players vs. game stats r=0.93, median ratio 1.01 (95 matches).

| `hit_actor` | int | yes |  | Hit actor network GUID |
| `target` | string | yes |  | Hit player_id; null = non-player hit (structures, props) |

| `critical` | bool | yes |  | Headshot |
| `shield` | bool | yes |  | Hit absorbed by shield |
| `shield_destroyed` | bool | yes |  |  |
| `ballistic` | bool | yes |  |  |
| `weapon_activate` | bool | yes |  |  |

| `y` | float | yes | uu |  |
| `z` | float | yes | uu |  |

### `fight_sides`

`data/processed/fight_sides.parquet`. Grain: fight x team. Key: `fight_id, team_index`.

Damage-based fights (architecture 1.1, src/fnf/fights.py): player-to-player damage between teams, segmented per team pair, merged into fights when segments sharing a team overlap in time.

| column | type | null | unit | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fight_id` | string |  |  | f'{match_id}:{n}', n in t0 order within the match; deterministic |
| `match_id` | string |  |  | Replay file stem |
| `team_index` | int |  |  | This side's team (at hit time) |
| `opp_team_index` | int |  |  | Primary opponent: the other fight team this side exchanged the most damage with |
| `t0` | float |  | s | Engagement start: first engagement damage of the fight (same for all sides) |
| `t_end` | float |  | s | Last engagement damage of the fight |
| `players` | string |  |  | ';'-separated player_ids of this side that dealt or took engagement damage |
| `outcome` | string |  |  | win \| loss \| tie \| disengage (first opposing-team knock in [t0, t_end + GRACE_S] decides) |
| `multi_team` | bool |  |  | More than two teams in the fight; excluded from v1 training |
| `n_damage_events` | int |  |  | Engagement damage events involving this side (dealt or taken) |
| `hits_dealt` | int |  |  | Engagement hits this side landed on the fight's other teams |
| `hits_taken` | int |  |  | Engagement hits this side took from the fight's other teams |
| `damage_dealt` | float |  |  | Damage this side dealt to the fight's other teams |
| `damage_taken` | float |  |  | Damage this side took from the fight's other teams |
| `recorder_involved` | bool |  |  | matches.replay_owner is among the fight's engaged players (any side) |
| `has_bots` | bool |  |  | Any engaged player in the fight (any side) is a bot |
| `mutual` | bool |  |  | Fight-level: at least two teams dealt player damage |
| `minority_damage_share` | float |  |  | Fight-level: second-largest dealing team's share of the fight's total damage (0 if one-sided) |
| `engagement_type` | string |  |  | Fight-level: fight \| poke. Poke = not mutual, or minority_damage_share < POKE_MIN_SHARE; never dropped |
| `dist_median_m` | float | yes | m | Fight-level: median shooter-target distance over hits; null if positions unknown |
| `dist_max_m` | float | yes | m | Fight-level: max shooter-target distance over hits; null if positions unknown |
